svg.aria-label: The shop takes an order and checks the stock. When the items are in stock, the warehouse packs them while the shop sends the invoice; the order ships when both are done. Otherwise the shop tells the customer and the order is closed.

The shop takes an order and checks the stock. When the items are in stock, the warehouse packs them while the shop sends the invoice; the order ships when both are done. Otherwise the shop tells the customer and the order is closed.

ol.li: Shop: Decide: if in stock, go to the fork; if else, go to Tell the customer.
Warehouse: The path splits; these run at the same time: Pack the items; Send the invoice.
Warehouse: Wait here until every path that comes in is done.
Shop: Send the signal “Send the invoice”. Then back to the join after Pack the items.
Shop: This path ends; the other paths go on.

ul.li: A filled dot: where it starts.
A box with round corners: an action, one step of the work.
A hollow diamond: the path splits by a condition, or paths join again.
A thick bar: the path splits into paths that run at the same time, or those paths wait for each other.
A plain box: a thing that the actions pass on, with its state in brackets.
A box with a point: a signal is sent.
A ring around a filled dot: the activity ends.
A ring with a cross: this path ends here, and the other paths go on.
A solid line with an open arrowhead: the order of the steps. A condition in brackets says when that path is taken.
A column with a name: who does the actions in it.
